items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: He said Oscar was actually trying to play that... But he was pianistically influenced by Art but musically he was more influenced by Dizzy. He said Dizzy was his main influence.

ctx.x: But he said the same thing, sort of, at least in a story I heard, that when he heard Art Tatum he said, “Man I can’t play.” So it’s all relative.

Man he had this funny story. He said Art, on this recording was playing this run and he was driving himself nuts trying to figure it out. So when Art got in town he sat ringside, right next to the piano, till he played that run. He said he was dragging his thumb. Playing notes and dragging his thumb. And he said Oscar was actually trying to play that and he was saying it’s not on the piano. You know? He said he was dragging his thumb. But he was pianistically influenced by Art but musically he was more influenced…
What did you learn from Dizzy?
